verdict.rationale: Kong lets you configure plugins and policies declaratively or via the Admin API, and these act automatically on each request: traffic controls, rate limiting, request/response transformations, logging, and DLP guardrails on AI traffic. That is per-request policy enforcement, not general event-driven rules that fire actions. missing for 10: user-defined event-trigger rules (e.g. event hooks/webhooks on entity or system events), action types beyond request handling, any documentation of rule/condition authoring for automation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
